INSTANTSEARCH
# Build modern search and agentic experiences faster
UI components and SDKs that help developers ship high-performing search, discovery, recommendation, and conversational experiences across any device without building every interaction pattern from scratch.
[ Get started ](https://dashboard.algolia.com/users/sign_up)
[ Request a demo ](https://www.algolia.com/demorequest/)
##  Built to unlock the full potential of Algolia’s search infrastructure
Algolia’s UI Component Libraries help you turn powerful search APIs into fast, flexible frontend experiences. Start with proven search and discovery patterns, then extend them into AI-powered and agent-driven interactions with the control your team needs.
##### Search as you type
Show relevant results from the first keystroke, powered by Algolia’s speed and relevance.
##### Federated search
Surface different types of content in a single, unified interface.
[ Try it out  ](https://codesandbox.io/s/github/algolia/solutions/tree/master/federated-search-is4-demo)
##### Filters and facets
Help users narrow results quickly with customizable filtering and faceting components built for real-world catalogs.
##### Sorting & pagination
Give users clear ways to explore results, compare options, and move through large result sets without friction.
##### Recommend
Encourage users to expand their search and browse to find similar or complementary items.
##### Agent Studio SDK components
Build conversational interfaces, guided discovery flows, and agent-assisted workflows that connect search, product data, business logic, and LLM-powered experiences.
[ Read the docs ](https://www.algolia.com/doc/guides/building-search-ui/what-is-instantsearch/js/)
##  Enhance your UX
#####  Improve your user experience across all platforms
InstantSearch packages best practices and proven design patterns into customizable components, so teams can build fast, intuitive search and discovery experiences for web, mobile, and native applications.
Use ready-to-use widgets where they accelerate development, or customize the interface, behavior, and ranking logic where your experience needs more control.
#####  Add AI-powered and conversational experiences
Move beyond static search results with components that help users ask questions, refine intent, and discover the next best result faster. Agent Studio SDK components give developers building blocks for conversational search, retrieval-powered experiences, guided discovery, and intelligent workflows. Connect Algolia search and product data to LLM-powered interfaces while keeping control over how the experience looks, behaves, and performs.
##  Built for developers
Algolia provides frontend libraries for the frameworks developers already use. Each library follows the concepts, coding patterns, and UX best practices of its framework, so teams can move quickly from a basic search UI to more advanced AI search and agent-driven experiences. Build with prebuilt components, compose your own flows, and customize the experience end to end without giving up performance or flexibility.

## Privacy Preference Center
When you visit any website, it may store or retrieve information on your browser, mostly in the form of cookies. This information might be about you, your preferences, or your device, and is mostly used to make the site work as you expect. The information does not usually identify you directly, but it can give you a more personalized web experience. Because we respect your right to privacy, you can choose not to allow some types of cookies. Click on the different category headings to learn more and change our default settings. Blocking some types of cookies may impact your experience of the site and the services we are able to offer. [More information](https://www.algolia.com/policies/cookies/)
Allow All
###  Manage Consent Preferences
#### Strictly Necessary Cookies
Always Active
These cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off in our systems. They are usually only set in response to actions made by you which amount to a request for services, such as setting your privacy preferences, logging in or filling in forms. You can set your browser to block or alert you about these cookies, but some parts of the site will not then work. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable information.
#### Performance Cookies
Performance Cookies
These cookies allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site. They help us to know which pages are the most and least popular and see how visitors move around the site. If you do not allow these cookies we will not know when you have visited our site.
#### Functional Cookies
Functional Cookies
These cookies enable the website to provide enhanced functionality and personalisation. They may be set by us or by third party providers whose services we have added to our pages. If you do not allow these cookies then some or all of these services may not function properly.
#### Targeting Cookies
Targeting Cookies
These cookies may be set through our site by our advertising partners. They may be used by those companies to build a profile of your interests and show you relevant adverts on other sites. They do not store directly personal information, but are based on uniquely identifying your browser and internet device. If you do not allow these cookies, you will experience less targeted advertising.

# Build modern search and agentic experiences faster
UI components and SDKs that help developers ship high-performing search, discovery, recommendation, and conversational experiences across any device without building every interaction pattern from scratch.
[ Get started ](https://dashboard.algolia.com/users/sign_up)
[ Request a demo ](https://www.algolia.com/demorequest/)
![](https://www.algolia.com/files/live/sites/algolia-assets/files/ui-component-libraries/Instant_Search_V2-min.avif)
##  Built to unlock the full potential of Algolia’s search infrastructure
Algolia’s UI Component Libraries help you turn powerful search APIs into fast, flexible frontend experiences. Start with proven search and discovery patterns, then extend them into AI-powered and agent-driven interactions with the control your team needs.
##### Search as you type
Show relevant results from the first keystroke, powered by Algolia’s speed and relevance.
##### Federated search
Surface different types of content in a single, unified interface.
[ Try it out  ](https://codesandbox.io/s/github/algolia/solutions/tree/master/federated-search-is4-demo)
##### Filters and facets
Help users narrow results quickly with customizable filtering and faceting components built for real-world catalogs.
##### Sorting & pagination
Give users clear ways to explore results, compare options, and move through large result sets without friction.
##### Recommend
Encourage users to expand their search and browse to find similar or complementary items.
##### Agent Studio SDK components
Build conversational interfaces, guided discovery flows, and agent-assisted workflows that connect search, product data, business logic, and LLM-powered experiences.
[ Read the docs ](https://www.algolia.com/doc/guides/building-search-ui/what-is-instantsearch/js/)
##  Enhance your UX
![](https://www.algolia.com/files/live/sites/algolia-assets/files/ui-component-libraries/Features_Improve_your_user_13.svg)
#####  Improve your user experience across all platforms
InstantSearch packages best practices and proven design patterns into customizable components, so teams can build fast, intuitive search and discovery experiences for web, mobile, and native applications.
Use ready-to-use widgets where they accelerate development, or customize the interface, behavior, and ranking logic where your experience needs more control.
![](https://www.algolia.com/files/live/sites/algolia-assets/files/ui-component-libraries/IProduct__Rulest_14.avif)
#####  Add AI-powered and conversational experiences
Move beyond static search results with components that help users ask questions, refine intent, and discover the next best result faster.  
Agent Studio SDK components give developers building blocks for conversational search, retrieval-powered experiences, guided discovery, and intelligent workflows. Connect Algolia search and product data to LLM-powered interfaces while keeping control over how the experience looks, behaves, and performs.
##  Built for developers
Algolia provides frontend libraries for the frameworks developers already use. Each library follows the concepts, coding patterns, and UX best practices of its framework, so teams can move quickly from a basic search UI to more advanced AI search and agent-driven experiences.  
Build with prebuilt components, compose your own flows, and customize the experience end to end without giving up performance or flexibility.

##  Enhance your UX
#####  Improve your user experience across all platforms
InstantSearch packages best practices and proven design patterns into customizable components, so teams can build fast, intuitive search and discovery experiences for web, mobile, and native applications.
Use ready-to-use widgets where they accelerate development, or customize the interface, behavior, and ranking logic where your experience needs more control.
#####  Add AI-powered and conversational experiences
Move beyond static search results with components that help users ask questions, refine intent, and discover the next best result faster. Agent Studio SDK components give developers building blocks for conversational search, retrieval-powered experiences, guided discovery, and intelligent workflows. Connect Algolia search and product data to LLM-powered interfaces while keeping control over how the experience looks, behaves, and performs.
##  Built for developers
Algolia provides frontend libraries for the frameworks developers already use. Each library follows the concepts, coding patterns, and UX best practices of its framework, so teams can move quickly from a basic search UI to more advanced AI search and agent-driven experiences. Build with prebuilt components, compose your own flows, and customize the experience end to end without giving up performance or flexibility.

When you visit any website, it may store or retrieve information on your browser, mostly in the form of cookies. The information does not usually identify you directly, but it can give you a more personalized web experience. Because we respect your right to privacy, you can choose not to allow some types of cookies. Click on the different category headings to learn more and change our default settings. #### Strictly Necessary Cookies
Always Active
These cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off in our systems. They are usually only set in response to actions made by you which amount to a request for services, such as setting your privacy preferences, logging in or filling in forms. You can set your browser to block or alert you about these cookies, but some parts of the site will not then work. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable information.
#### Performance Cookies
Performance Cookies
These cookies allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site. They help us to know which pages are the most and least popular and see how visitors move around the site. If you do not allow these cookies we will not know when you have visited our site.
#### Functional Cookies
Functional Cookies
These cookies enable the website to provide enhanced functionality and personalisation. They may be set by us or by third party providers whose services we have added to our pages. If you do not allow these cookies then some or all of these services may not function properly.
#### Targeting Cookies
Targeting Cookies
These cookies may be set through our site by our advertising partners. They may be used by those companies to build a profile of your interests and show you relevant adverts on other sites. They do not store directly personal information, but are based on uniquely identifying your browser and internet device. If you do not allow these cookies, you will experience less targeted advertising.
